# Estate Planning Specialists

> The UK accountancy firm for the money side of wills, probate and inheritance tax: free calculators, plain-English guides, and a solicitor introduction when the matter needs one.

## Who we are
Estate Planning Specialists is the UK's specialist accountancy firm for probate, wills and inheritance tax planning. We handle the money side of an estate: inheritance tax calculations, probate cost estimates, estate accounts and IHT reliefs. Where you need a solicitor, we work alongside a regulated firm and stay on the money side. Estate Planning Specialists is a trading name of Ashfield Trading Ltd, company number 16358723, registered office 20 Ashfield Avenue, Shipley, Bradford, BD18 3AL.

We act for UK executors, administrators and people planning their own estates, from a single probate application to ongoing inheritance tax planning for a family.

We act for clients across the United Kingdom and work remotely, by phone, video and email.

## How it works
1. You tell us your situation through the enquiry form: what the estate involves and what you need looked at.
2. One of our accountants calls you to go through it and answer the immediate questions.
3. We agree the scope and the fee before any work starts.
4. We do the work on the money side and work alongside a regulated solicitor if the matter needs one.

What happens after the form: We reply within 24 hours and one of our accountants comes back to you directly.

## Pillar guides
- [Probate](https://www.estateplanningspecialists.co.uk/probate?utm_source=chatgpt&utm_medium=llms): Applying for probate, costs, timelines and when it is not needed.
- [Wills](https://www.estateplanningspecialists.co.uk/wills?utm_source=chatgpt&utm_medium=llms): Making a will, intestacy, and what happens without one.
- [Inheritance tax](https://www.estateplanningspecialists.co.uk/inheritance-tax?utm_source=chatgpt&utm_medium=llms): Nil rate bands, reliefs, and the April 2027 pension changes.
- [Lasting power of attorney](https://www.estateplanningspecialists.co.uk/lasting-power-of-attorney?utm_source=chatgpt&utm_medium=llms): Setting up an LPA for property, finance or health and welfare.
